quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns drivers about hazards ahead or nearby.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns drivers about hazards ahead or nearby.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: A school bus on the opposite side of a divided highway has its lights flashing. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the lights stop flashing.

questions.explanation: You may keep driving when a school bus with flashing lights is on the opposite side of a divided highway.

questions.question: How long does it take for your body to get over the effects of one 12-ounce beer?
questions.explanation: It takes about one hour for your body to process one drink. Other factors can make this longer. The safest choice is not to drive if you have been drinking.

questions.question: You are driving in another driver's blind spot. What should you do?

options.text: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
Stay in the driver's blind spot.
Honk your horn to warn them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
questions.explanation: Do not stay in another driver's blind spot. Move ahead or fall back so they can see you.

questions.question: What does a downward-facing triangle sign mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangle signs tell drivers to yield. You can proceed when the road is clear and it is safe.

questions.question: When can you drive around a lowering railroad crossing gate?

options.text: If you have time to cross before it closes.
If there is a shoulder to the right.

questions.explanation: Never drive around railroad crossing gates. Stay in place until the gates are fully raised. It is illegal to go around the gates.

questions.question: How can you avoid alcohol-related crash risks?

options.text: Decide before drinking that you will not drive.
Tell people "no" if they offer you a drink when you are driving.

questions.explanation: The best way to stay safe is to decide before drinking that you will not drive. Alcohol affects judgment, making it hard to make safe choices once you have started drinking.

questions.question: What happens if you refuse a chemical test when police ask for one?

options.text: 10 points are added to your license.

questions.explanation: Refusing a chemical test results in two criminal charges: DUI and Refusal. Your license will be revoked and 10 points will be added.

questions.question: Where are stop lines (solid white lines) painted across traffic lanes?
questions.explanation: Stop lines are solid white lines at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show where you must stop.

questions.question: Which drugs can affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Many drugs can affect driving. This includes illegal drugs and over-the-counter or prescription medications. Driving while impaired by any drug is a crime.

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is illegal to drive around lowered gates at a crossing.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger tells you to.
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red signals and gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger signals you, or when you see a stop sign or warning devices like gates or flashing lights. Not all railroad crossings have these devices. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad crossing gates.

questions.question: When you see an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop only if you are involved in the accident or if help has not arrived yet.

questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Stay focused on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not drive to accident scenes just to look.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the side of the road and empty.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are off.
On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: You must stop when a school bus shows flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop. Stay stopped as long as the red lights are flashing and the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Return to your lane within 10 feet of the vehicle you passed.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Return to your lane only when you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block the normal flow of traffic. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: To avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots, you should:

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move. Check that your blind spot is clear. Never rely only on mirrors.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: In good driving conditions, you should stay at least this distance behind other vehicles:
questions.explanation: In good driving conditions, keep at least a four-second distance between you and the vehicle ahead. Increase this distance when conditions are worse.
